cards.title: Bear markets create opportunities—and traps
cards.question: When is a beaten-down AI stock a trap?
cards.prompt: Apply handwritten HL010 to Nov 13 AI-stock dispersion and the October-November correction. Compare durable product demand, net debt, liquidity, financing commitments, earnings revisions and upcoming product milestones. Avoid treating lower share price as proof of value. https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-dip-nvidia-tumult-keeps-investors-edge-2026-11-13/

cards.title: Build the company story before the ticker trade
cards.question: What business evidence survives the selloff?
cards.prompt: Apply handwritten HL013 to Nov 10 TSMC +59.7% year-on-year October revenue and Nov 12-13 divergence among AI hardware providers. Write a 6-12 month technology, customer, margin and financing thesis, including dated milestone and disconfirmation. This lesson is not a price prediction. https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3349 https://www.reuters.com/business/cerebras-raises-annual-sales-forecast-strong-ai-linked-demand-2026-11-12/
